citations.assessment: The testimony before Rabbi concerns an animal with two intestinal outlets. The witness identifies Natan bar Shila as chief butcher in Tzippori.
This distinct testimony is in the name of R. Natan and concerns identifying the inner rumen. Its fuller office title matches Heilprin’s wording.
